request.description: Opens the next draft. Send `content`, or `fromNumber` to copy an earlier version; with neither, the latest published version (or the latest version) is copied. Only one version can be in progress (draft, in review or approved) at a time. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).
